purpose: Model development only; latest-vintage research; no production selection before Part 6
target_assumption: Each source-date record becomes known the next Asia/Beirut midnight. Effective dates and complete decision coverage remain unverified.
calendar_assumption: Last recorded price at endpoint conditional on observed archive completeness. Never a newly observed daily official price.
market_availability: Research close convention: daily d 23:59:59 UTC; weekly EIA d+5 at 23:59:59 UTC. EIA spot T-1 is an optimistic research assumption, not its verified release history. Strict mode retains actual capture/vintage clocks. Latest-vintage revision risk remains.

regimes.part6_period: 2018-01-01 through 2019-08-31; already examined in Part 4, not globally untouched
June-November 2026 evaluation, separate export; no model fitting in this stage.
regimes.regime_status: unified research bucket under user-specified stable-FX assumption; fiscal breaks remain in data

structural_status: B official requires complete dated inputs and abstains if absent. B_structural_proxy is a positive estimated composite pass-through under constant policy and flat future market scenarios, never official FX/formula.
news: Optional deterministic channel classification; strict known-at availability; no zero-filled unknown historical news coverage; no paid API
part6_reservation: Development stops 2026-05-31; June-November targets go only to holdout_evaluation_design.csv. Prior stages already viewed some history; not a globally untouched holdout. No tuning, fitting or accuracy claims in this stage.

structural_delta.assumption_status: User-specified sensitivity assumptions, not verified current government parameters
structural_delta.equation: delta(mean4 USD/bbl)*1000/158.987294928*89700*1.01*1.11/50 after stabilization; preceding periods use trailing median price/product ratio (fees already embedded).
structural_delta.baseline_window: Four available trading observations at latest known domestic source date, 03:00 Asia/Beirut; exact announcement/calculation windows unresolved.
structural_delta.shock_interpretation: Large lagged price movement; may reflect commodity, FX or tax changes. Not proof of a fiscal decree.
structural_delta.limitations: Constant charges cancel only between policy changes. Constant FX, bank fee and VAT are hypotheses. No licensed CIF Med benchmark or roll adjustment is available.

futures_provenance.provider: Yahoo public chart daily unadjusted close; continuous front-symbol roll calendar unknown

symbols.RB=F: NYMEX RBOB US gasoline, not Mediterranean 95

futures_provenance.fallback: Retain futures as unavailable; choose fresh brent_spot/nyh_gasoline explicitly in derived features. No heating-oil substitute.
futures_provenance.short_windows: Means of last 3/4/5/10 observed trading sessions; return3/return5 compare against 3/5 observed sessions earlier; no holiday filling.
